name: PM Fasal Bima Yojana (crop insurance)
benefit: Crop insurance against yield loss, subject to notified crops/areas and enrolment deadlines

rules.text: Must grow a notified crop in a notified area this season

manual_checks: Notified crops/area and last enrolment date for this season
application_steps: Check the notified crops and last enrolment date for your area on pmfby.gov.in or with your bank/CSC.
Keep land record, bank passbook and sowing details ready.
Enrol through your bank, CSC or the official portal before the deadline.
Save the policy/receipt number in the Applications tab.
